europe_now.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with deadly Russian strikes on civilian targets
europe_now.summary: Russian forces launched a fresh wave of attacks across Ukraine, killing civilians and prompting European leaders to pledge additional military support, including interceptor missiles from France. The escalation underscores growing concerns over energy infrastructure and civilian safety amid intensified hostilities.

europe_now.title: Forest fires and flash floods impact multiple European regions
europe_now.summary: Severe wildfires in France and Spain, alongside flash floods in Spain, have displaced residents and disrupted transportation networks across southern Europe. Authorities have declared emergencies and evacuated thousands as extreme weather events strain regional resources.

top_stories.title: Zelenskyy rejects wartime elections, citing national unity risks
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reiterated his opposition to holding elections during the ongoing war, warning that it could deepen divisions within the country. His stance comes amid internal political pressure and international debate over democratic processes in conflict zones.
